item.title: Suspect in Sawani home break-in identified but yet to be arrested
item.description: The suspect who broke into a house at around 11.30pm last Sunday in Sawani, Nausori, has been identified but not arrested. Sandeep Prakash told fijivillage News that his family does not want to continue living in fear.
item.content:encoded:
The suspect who broke into a house at around 11.30pm last Sunday in Sawani, Nausori, has been identified but not arrested.

Sandeep Prakash told fijivillage News that his family does not want to continue living in fear.

Prakash says his 15-year-old daughter has been left shaken by the incident and cannot sleep at night due to fear.

Prakash says he was informed by the Nausori Police Station that the same suspect is involved in three other matters.

The homeowner has also thanked members of the community who assisted the family in identifying the suspect.

Police have not made any comments on the progress of the investigations.

item.title: 24 jobs created as Kasabias Hardware opens new Labasa outlet
item.description: 24 new jobs have been created following the opening of a new Kasabias Hardware outlet in Labasa Town. The new outlet is expected to make hardware shopping more convenient for customers in Labasa.
item.content:encoded:
24 new jobs have been created following the opening of a new Kasabias Hardware outlet in Labasa Town.

The new outlet is expected to make hardware shopping more convenient for customers in Labasa.

Kasabias Hardware Manager Aniketh Prasad says the decision to open the shop on the main street was driven by high demand from customers.

He says customers previously faced difficulties travelling to the Kasabias outlet at Naseakula to purchase hardware supplies.

Prasad says the new location will make it easier for customers to access the shop and purchase their hardware supplies.

He says customers will also have the option of purchasing items on credit.

Prasad says the outlet stocks a wide range of hardware items that are in demand and assures customers that quality products are available.
